Stranded in the Sirius Sector, the Detachments settled a number of worlds which they have adapted to their unique needs. The Detachments changed over time as well, becoming more distinct and developing their own ideas of how best to serve their Founder. Now, Detachments struggle to maintain a sense of unity and purpose as they become more distinct. Following the genetic innovations of the Founder, the Battle Brothers were soon deployed to maintain unity and peace over Earth and its nearby colonies. [Read more lore on our website](https://www.onepagerules.com/factions/battle-brothers) ### Army-Wide Special Rules Watchborn: When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation, when shooting or charging enemies over 9" away, all models with this rule in this unit either get AP(+1) or get +1 to hit rolls. ### Special Rules Lacerate: When attacking the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6. Mend: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly model within 3" with Tough, and remove D3 wounds from it. Re-Position Artillery: Once per activation, pick one friendly model within 6" with Artillery, which may immediately move by up to 9". Shielded: Units where all models have this rule get +1 to defense rolls against hits that are not from spells. Strafing: Once per activation, when this model moves through enemy units, pick one of them and attack it with this weapon as if it was shooting. This weapon may only be used in this way. Unstoppable Mark: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Unstoppable against once (next time the effect would apply). ### Aura Special Rules Bane in Melee Aura: This model and its unit get Bane in melee. Bane when Shooting Aura: This model and its unit get Bane when shooting. Courage Aura: This model and its unit get +1 to morale test rolls. Melee Shrouding Aura: This model and its unit get Melee Shrouding. Rapid Rush Aura: This model and its unit get Rapid Rush. Regeneration Aura: This model and its unit get Regeneration. Shred when Shooting Aura: This model and its unit get Shred when shooting. Versatile Reach Aura: This model and its unit get Versatile Reach. Read more ### Spells Watch Sight (1): Pick one enemy unit within 18", which friendly units gets Unstoppable when shooting against once (next time the effect would apply). Watch Trauma (1): Pick one enemy unit within 18", which takes 1 hit with Blast(3) and Lacerate. Blessed Ammo (2): Pick up to two friendly units within 12", which get Shred when shooting once (next time the effect would apply). Lightning Fog (2): Pick up to two enemy units within 9", which take 4 hits each. Watch Dome (3): Pick up to three friendly units within 12", which get Evasive once (next time the effect would apply). Psychic Terror (3): Pick one enemy unit within 6", which takes 9 hits with Bane. ### Units ### Heroes Watch Master Destroyer [1] Qua 3+Def 3+ 140pts CCW(A4) Ambush, Fearless, Hero, Shielded, Tough(6),
